# GitHub Repository Structure

This repository contains the Classify AI multi-agent classification system.

## Repository Organization

### Main Directories

- **`backend/`** - FastAPI backend application
- **`frontend/`** - Next.js frontend application
- **`docs/`** - All project documentation
- **`docker/`** - Docker configurations and Dockerfiles
- **`config/`** - Configuration files and examples
- **`test_data/`** - Sample datasets for testing

### Documentation Structure

All documentation is organized in the `docs/` directory:

- **`docs/important/`** - Critical documentation and important notes
- **`docs/fixes/`** - Bug fixes, root cause analyses, and technical improvements
- **`docs/changelog/`** - Project status updates and changelog
- **`docs/guides/`** - User guides and quick start documentation
- **`docs/architecture/`** - Technical architecture documentation
- **`docs/test-results/`** - Test results and evaluation reports

## Important Files

- **`README.md`** - Main project README
- **`.gitignore`** - Git ignore rules
- **`LICENSE`** - Project license
- **`backend/requirements.txt`** - Python dependencies
- **`frontend/package.json`** - Node.js dependencies

## Getting Started

See the main `README.md` for setup and running instructions.

## Contributing

This is a capstone project. For questions, see the documentation in `docs/`.
